Name: Higuruma Hiromi NPC - Jujutsu Kaisen
Author: yujihat
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Brief Overview[/u]

[/size][/b][size=2]Everyone's favorite attorney came to have his career crisis in Pelican Town.

[b]He is compatible with the Gojo mod by cursedcure!! Also compatible with my other mods.[/b]

[/size][u][size=4][b]Gift Likes/Dislikes[/b][/size][/u][size=2]

[b]Loves[/b]: Aged Roe, Caviar, Banana Pudding, Maki Roll, Omelet, Blueberries, Blueberry Tart, Triple Shot Espresso, Sunflower, Coffee

[b]Likes[/b]: Cranberry, Pink Cake, Ancient Fruit, Sweet Gem Berry, Wine, Green Tea

[b]Neutral[/b]: Universal Neutrals

[b]Dislikes[/b]: Cheese, Goat Cheese, Milk, L Milk, Ice Cream, Goat Milk, L Goat Milk, Cheese Cauliflower

[b]Hates[/b]: Rabbit's Foot, Lucky Lunch, Universal Hates

[/size][size=4][b][u]Schedule
[/u][/b][/size][size=2]
Monday, Wednesday, Friday

Starts the day at Mayor's Manor
0900 Heads to Library to work
1700 Heads to Saloon for a drink
2200 Returns to Mayor's Manor

Tuesday, Thursday

Starts the day at Mayor's Manor
0900 Heads to Hospital
1100 Relaxes on a bench in town
1700 Heads to Saloon for a drink
2200 Returns to Mayor's Manor

Saturday, Sunday
Starts the day at Mayor's Manor and loafs about
1700 Heads to Saloon for a drink
2200 Returns to Mayor's Manor


[/size][size=4][b]Heart Events (He only has two right now)[/b][/size][size=2][size=2]

[b][u]Two Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Monday, Wednesday or Friday head to the Library between 1000 and 1700.

[b][u]Four Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On any day head to the Saloon between 1700 and 2200.
